name: SNMP-Exporter
description: SNMP Exporter is a Prometheus exporter for SNMP-capable network devices and appliances (switches, routers, NAS, UPS, etc). It ships with a large library of pre-built MIB-to-metric mappings (snmp.yml) covering most major vendors, and exposes metrics for any polled target at /snmp?target=<ip>&module=<name>.

notes.text: The default `snmp.yml` ships with generator modules for most common vendors (if_mib, printer_mib, etc). Edit `/opt/snmp_exporter/snmp.yml` and restart the service to add or customize modules for your devices.
Point Prometheus at this exporter using the SNMP `snmp` job pattern: scrape `/snmp?target=<device-ip>&module=<module-name>` with `__address__` set to this container's IP:9116.
